rows.label: tlk70000045_02_msg0001
rows.name:
Those huge one-eyed things were scary,
mo~.

rows.label: tlk70000045_02_msg0002
rows.name:
And it wasn't just Rikoko. Everyone
was scared, so the whole city has
gotten gloomy, mo~.

rows.label: tlk70000045_02_msg0003
rows.name:
At times like this, those traveling
performers would cheer everyone up
with bright music, mo.

rows.label: tlk70000045_02_msg0004
rows.name:
Rikoko wants to cheer everyone up with
this flute too, but playing alone is
still too embarrassing, mo~.
